Boardroom Alpha · Executive Brief

The chief executive of [Bausch + Lomb](https://app.boardroomalpha.com/profiles/companies/GKJY9GKY-bausch-lomb-corp) (BLCO), Brent Saunders, signed his exit agreement on Sunday and was gone at 12:01 a.m. Monday. The company will pay him $75.5 million in cash. Thomas Appio, chief executive of [Bausch Health](https://app.boardroomalpha.com/profiles/companies/QTK2JBXD-bausch-health-companies-inc) (BHC), which owns 87% of Bausch + Lomb, is now also interim chief executive of Bausch + Lomb, filling in until a permanent one is named. No search has been announced.

Bausch Health owns enough shares to decide almost any shareholder vote, and it had been reshaping the board since August, when it asked for four new directors and Appio succeeded Saunders as chairman. What Bausch + Lomb has not disclosed is a plan for the day after. That leaves the outside shareholders, who own the other 13%, with an interim chief executive who also runs the parent.
